item.title: University of Alabama student hospitalized after fall in Dominican Republic
item.description: A freshman at the University of Alabama is fighting for his life in the Dominican Republic after an accident during Christmas break.Matthew Polaski was on a family vacation when he fell on Dec. 28, 2025. He was rushed to the hospital, where doctors performed surgery and placed him in a medically induced coma to allow brain swelling to subside. item.title: Tuscaloosa teen dead after shot while playing with gun
item.description: A Tuscaloosa teenager is dead after an accidental shooting on New Year’s Day.Tuscaloosa Police were called to the scene in McKenzie Court apartments at 6:30 p.m.ABC 33/40 reported that the 15-year-old accidentally shot himself while playing with the gun. item.title: Will Sellers: Radical common sense
item.description: Two hundred fifty years ago on January 10, 1776, Thomas Paine published his influential pamphlet, “Common Sense.” In today’s word, its publication went “viral” as it was re-printed and distributed throughout the American Colonies.At the time of its circulation, the colonies were in a state of flux. item.title: Body of Walker County boy found with dog by his side
item.description: Walker County Sheriff Nick Smith said a boy reported missing on Wednesday was found dead two miles from his home on Friday.Johnathan Everett Boley, 5, was last seen with his black lab, which Smith said was found alive and still with the child.Walker County deputies have been searching the woods and ponds in the 7000 block of Highway 195 in Jasper, using all resources available.The cause of death has not been determined.To connect with the author of this story or to comment, email erica.thomas@18
